description: Multi-source dataset containing rice leaf images categorized into 5 disease/condition classes.

classes.description: Caused by Xanthomonas oryzae, leading to wilting of seedlings and yellowing/drying of leaves.
Caused by the fungus Magnaporthe oryzae, producing diamond-shaped lesions on leaves.
Fungal disease caused by Bipolaris oryzae, producing brown oval spots on leaves.
Healthy rice leaf foliage showing vibrant green coloration with no visible lesions.
Viral disease transmitted by green leafhoppers, causing stunting and yellow-orange leaf discoloration.
